terra.problem: The verse does not say that nothing was handed down to the prophets.
“No writing” adds a detail the passage does not give.
“Nobody picked up a single stone” adds an action the text does not mention.
The text says they did not go up to the gaps or restore the wall; it does not say they climbed up to fix them.
The text does not say the prophets never went near the wall.
The claim that famine occurs in Scripture is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
The claim about exiles in the rest of Ezekiel needs a reference outside this passage.
The drawer joke does not match the action being compared: doing nothing does not explain expecting a message to come true. It also overlooks Papa Dorin's work welcoming newcomers in the drawer.
“Nobody confesses a thing” states more than the passage says.
The passage does not say that people believed the message because peace was a nice word.
The passage does not say the prophets kept the mood light or that nobody told anyone to turn around.
“Nobody stood watch” adds a detail the passage does not give.
God tells Ezekiel to speak to the whitewashers, not an unidentified group described as “them.”
“Nobody walks away from that rubble” goes beyond the judgment stated against those addressed.
Calling the condemned prophets the “paint crew” makes a light joke in the line about their destruction.
The passage gives the women a distinct rebuke; it does not say they receive the same direct word as the prophets.
“I'll say once that this part is heavy” comments on how Papa Dorin is presenting the passage.
“I won't joke on it” comments on how Papa Dorin is presenting the passage.
The passage says God will free the ensnared souls; it does not say they will not be judged.
The passage says the women encouraged the wicked not to turn from their evil ways; it does not say the wicked felt comforted.
The claim about exiles elsewhere in Ezekiel needs a reference outside this passage.
The claim that elders appear elsewhere in Ezekiel needs a reference outside this passage.
